name: LaborDesk — Collective Bargaining & Labor Relations
description: Simulation where participants negotiate a collective bargaining agreement between management and a union at a Colombian plastics manufacturer, balancing wage demands, safety investments, production flexibility, and relationship preservation across four structured negotiation rounds.

(function() { 'use strict'; class LaborDeskAdapter extends USF.SimulationAdapter { constructor() { super(); this.name = 'LaborDesk — Collective Bargaining & Labor Relations'; this.version = '1.1.0'; this.ROUNDS = [ { theme: 'preparation', title: 'Round 1 — Preparation & Position Setting', description: 'The current CBA at Plasticos del Valle expires in 45 days. As management, you must set your initial negotiating position.

Context: The company ($280M revenue, 1,200 unionized workers) needs a production flexibility clause to compete with imports. The union has filed a pliego de peticiones demanding a 12% wage increase and improved safety standards after two workplace incidents.

Your task: Set your opening wage offer, safety investment budget, flexibility clause strength, and negotiation tone. This round establishes your BATNA and credibility.', events: [ { id: 'intel_report', icon: '📊', text: 'Your HR team has obtained informal intelligence: the union leadership is divided. The president favors a collaborative approach, but the vice-president is pushing for a hard line. A moderate opening may exploit this division.' }, { id: 'board_pressure', icon: '👔', text: 'The Board of Directors has communicated that total CBA cost increases above 8% of current labor costs will require a special board vote. This constrains your flexibility on wages.' } ] }, { theme: 'opening', title: 'Round 2 — Opening Positions & Exploration', description: 'Both sides have exchanged opening positions. The union opened at 12% wage increase, $400K safety investment, and rejected any flexibility clause.

Context: The gap between positions is significant but not unusual. Your tone and willingness to explore interests (rather than defend positions) will determine whether the negotiation moves toward integrative bargaining or hardens into a distributive fight.

Your task: Adjust your position based on the union response. Consider what trades might be possible.', events: [ { id: 'wildcat_action', icon: '⚠️', text: 'CRISIS: A spontaneous work slowdown has begun in Department 4. Production is down 30% in that unit. The union denies involvement but has not condemned it. How you respond will affect both the negotiation and operational continuity.' }, { id: 'media_leak', icon: '📰', text: 'CRISIS: The union opening position has been leaked to El Tiempo newspaper. The headline reads: "Workers at Plasticos del Valle demand living wages amid record profits." Public pressure is mounting on management.' } ] }, { theme: 'bargaining', title: 'Round 3 — Core Bargaining & Trade Development', description: 'Negotiations have entered the substantive phase. Both sides have moved from opening positions but remain apart on key issues.

Context: The union has signaled willingness to discuss flexibility if safety investment is substantial. This is a potential integrative trade: management gets flexibility, union gets safety. But the wage gap remains the hardest issue.

Your task: Develop a package proposal that bundles trades across multiple issues. Consider whether to request a mediator.', events: [ { id: 'safety_incident', icon: '🚨', text: 'BREAKING: A minor chemical spill has occurred in Plant B during the morning shift. Two workers treated for skin irritation. The union has called an emergency meeting. Safety investment just became the top priority at the table.' }, { id: 'mediator_offer', icon: '⚖️', text: 'The Ministry of Labor has offered to provide a mediator at no cost to either party. Accepting mediation signals willingness to compromise but may slow the process. The arbitration deadline is in 15 days.' } ] }, { theme: 'agreement', title: 'Round 4 — Final Agreement or Arbitration', description: 'This is the final round. You must present your best and final offer. If the union accepts, you have a new CBA. If rejected, the dispute goes to binding arbitration where neither party controls the outcome.

Context: Arbitration in Colombia typically splits the difference on wages but can be unpredictable on non-monetary issues. Your BATNA (arbitration) is your alternative — but the relationship cost of arbitration is high.

Your task: Submit your final offer. Balance cost containment with agreement quality and relationship preservation.', events: [ { id: 'strike_threat', icon: '🔴', text: 'The union membership has voted to authorize a strike if no agreement is reached. The vote was 78% in favor. A strike would cost approximately $1.2M per week in lost production.' }, { id: 'competitor_deal', icon: '🏭', text: 'A competitor in Medellin just settled their CBA at 9.5% wage increase with strong flexibility provisions. Both sides are aware of this benchmark. It provides a credible reference point for settlement.' } ] } ]; } initialize(state) { if (!state.domainState || Object.keys(state.domainState).length === 0) { state.domainState = { budget: 4200000, budgetUsed: 0, relationshipHealth: 50, laborScore: 0, agreementQuality: 0, cumulativeWageOffer: 0, cumulativeSafety: 0, cumulativeFlexibility: 0, cumulativeTone: 0, roundScoreHistory: [], relationshipHistory: [], budgetHistory: [], activeEvent: null, eventApplied: false }; } if (!state.decisions || Object.keys(state.decisions).length === 0) { state.decisions = { wageOffer: 5, safetyInvestment: 100, flexibilityClause: 3, tone: 3 }; } this._updateBriefing(state); } validateDecisions(decisions) { var wageInput = document.getElementById('wageOfferInput'); if (wageInput) decisions.wageOffer = parseFloat(wageInput.value); var safetyInput = document.getElementById('safetyInput'); if (safetyInput) decisions.safetyInvestment = parseFloat(safetyInput.value); var flexInput = document.getElementById('flexibilityInput'); if (flexInput) decisions.flexibilityClause = parseInt(flexInput.value); var toneInput = document.getElementById('toneInput'); if (toneInput) decisions.tone = parseInt(toneInput.value); if (isNaN(decisions.wageOffer) || decisions.wageOffer < 0 || decisions.wageOffer > 15) { window.mySimulation.uiManager.showNotification(window.mySimulation.t('wage_warning'), 'warning'); return false; } if (isNaN(decisions.safetyInvestment) || decisions.safetyInvestment < 0 || decisions.safetyInvestment > 500) { window.mySimulation.uiManager.showNotification(window.mySimulation.t('safety_warning'), 'warning'); } this._updateBriefing(window.mySimulation.state); return true; } calculateResults(state) { var d = state.decisions; var ds = state.domainState; var round = Math.min((state.currentPeriod || 1) - 1, this.ROUNDS.length - 1); var roundData = this.ROUNDS[round]; var eventPool = roundData.events; var eventIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * eventPool.length); var event = eventPool[eventIndex]; ds.activeEvent = event; ds.eventApplied = true; var safetyTarget = 300; var safetySatisfaction = Math.min(100, (d.safetyInvestment / safetyTarget) * 100); var flexibilityResistance = (d.flexibilityClause - 1) * 15; var toneBonus = (d.tone - 1) * 8; var relationshipChange = 0; relationshipChange += (wageSatisfaction - 50) * 0.15; relationshipChange += (safetySatisfaction - 50) * 0.2; relationshipChange -= flexibilityResistance * 0.3; relationshipChange += toneBonus; } else if (event.id === 'safety_incident') { relationshipChange += (d.safetyInvestment >= 250) ? 10 : -10; } else if (event.id === 'mediator_offer') { if (d.tone >= 3) relationshipChange += 6; } else if (event.id === 'strike_threat') { relationshipChange -= 10; if (d.wageOffer >= 9 && d.safetyInvestment >= 200) relationshipChange += 12; } else if (event.id === 'competitor_deal') { if (d.wageOffer >= 8 && d.wageOffer <= 11) relationshipChange += 8; } else if (event.id === 'board_pressure') { if (d.wageOffer > 10) relationshipChange -= 3; } else if (event.id === 'intel_report') { if (d.tone >= 3 && d.tone <= 4) relationshipChange += 4; } ds.relationshipHealth = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ds.relationshipHealth + relationshipChange)); var integrativeValue = 0; agreementScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, agreementScore)); var processScore = 0; processScore += (d.tone >= 3) ? 20 : 5; processScore += (d.wageOffer >= 6 && d.wageOffer <= 11) ? 25 : 10; processScore += (d.safetyInvestment >= 150) ? 20 : 5; processScore += integrativeValue > 0 ? 20 : 0; processScore = Math.min(100, processScore); var financialScore = 0; var costRatio = roundCost / ds.budget; if (costRatio <= 0.06) financialScore = 90; else if (costRatio <= 0.08) financialScore = 75; else if (costRatio <= 0.10) financialScore = 55; else if (costRatio <= 0.13) financialScore = 35; else financialScore = 15; var roundScore = (agreementScore * 0.35) + (ds.relationshipHealth * 0.25) + (processScore * 0.25) + (financialScore * 0.15); roundScore = Math.round(Math.min(100, Math.max(0, roundScore))); ds.budgetUsed += roundCost; ds.cumulativeWageOffer = d.wageOffer; ds.cumulativeSafety += d.safetyInvestment; ds.cumulativeFlexibility = d.flexibilityClause; ds.cumulativeTone = ((ds.cumulativeTone * round) + d.tone) / (round + 1); ds.laborScore = roundScore; ds.agreementQuality = Math.round(agreementScore); ds.roundScoreHistory.push(roundScore); ds.relationshipHistory.push(Math.round(ds.relationshipHealth)); ds.budgetHistory.push(ds.budget - ds.budgetUsed); var self = this; var nextPeriod = (state.currentPeriod || 1) + 1; setTimeout(function() { self._updateBriefing({ currentPeriod: nextPeriod }); }, 500); return { period: state.currentPeriod, roundTheme: roundData.theme, wageOffer: d.wageOffer, safetyInvestment: d.safetyInvestment, flexibilityClause: d.flexibilityClause, tone: d.tone, roundCost: roundCost, relationshipHealth: Math.round(ds.relationshipHealth), agreementQuality: Math.round(agreementScore), processScore: Math.round(processScore), financialScore: Math.round(financialScore), roundScore: roundScore, eventName: event.id, budgetRemaining: ds.budget - ds.budgetUsed };
